items.label: Daily Loss Limit
items.detail: 5% of previous day's closing balance. 4% for $200k accounts. Resets at 17:00 EST. Floating + realized PnL combined. Intraday profits expand the limit.

items.label: Max Overall Loss
items.detail: 10% of initial balance. 8% for $200k accounts. Equity/balance must never drop below this floor.

items.label: Min Trading Days
items.detail: Minimum 3 active trading days per phase before claiming target.

items.label: Risk Per Trade Idea
items.detail: Max 2% of initial balance per trade idea (funded only). Correlated assets = 1 idea. New trade within 10 min of close = same idea. SL required. Violation = instant termination. Effective 7 Apr 2026.

items.label: Inactivity Limit
items.detail: No new trade in 30 consecutive days = permanent suspension.

items.label: Time Limit
items.detail: No maximum time to complete either phase.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: No restrictions on high-impact news in challenge or funded account.

items.label: Weekend Hold
items.detail: Positions may remain open over the weekend in challenge and funded.

items.label: Overnight Hold
items.detail: No restrictions on overnight positions in any phase.

items.label: Bi-Weekly
items.detail: Min 3 profitable days in 14 days. A profitable day = net closed profit ≥ 0.5% of initial balance.

items.label: Monthly
items.detail: Min 7 profitable days in 30 days. Same profitable-day definition applies.

items.label: On-Demand
items.detail: Consistency ≤ 40% (biggest day ÷ total profit) + min 2% total profit of initial balance.

rows: Bank Wire / Crypto (BTC, USDC, ETH, USDT)

items.label: Refund
items.detail: 25% returned with each of the first 4 payouts. Example: $409 fee → $102.25 per payout.

items.label: Swap-Free
items.detail: Example: $409 → $449.90. Must be selected at purchase.

items.label: Reset
items.detail: Example: $409 → $531.70. Restarts from Phase 1 regardless of which phase was breached. One use only.

items.label: Max Total Funded
items.detail: Combined cap across all active funded accounts (challenges + direct).

items.label: Merging
items.detail: Only 2-Step Prime funded accounts can be merged together. No open trades and not mid-payout-cycle required.

items.label: Platforms
items.value: DX Trade, MT4, MT5, Match Trader, Trade-Locker, CTrader
